# Ocean Horizon (`oceanHorizon`)

Open sea at golden hour, or live: the real sun, moon and weather crossing the day.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: sun, location, weather
- Cost: medium (~5.1 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Golden Hour, Tidewater, Afterlight

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `sun` | Sun Height | slider | -2 … 12 | 4 |
| `waves` | Sea State | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.45 |
| `clouds` | Clouds | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.55 |
| `haze` | Haze | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.55 |
| `live` | Follow the Sun | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `lapse` | Time Lapse | slider | 0 … 60 (step 1) | 0 |
| `weather` | Weather | menu | 0 Live · 1 Clear · 2 Partly Cloudy · 3 Overcast · 4 Fog · 5 Rain · 6 Storm · 7 Snow | 0 (Live) |
| `lightning` | Lightning | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Deep Water | {"r":0.02,"g":0.09,"b":0.13} |
| `colorB` | Sunlight | {"r":1,"g":0.85,"b":0.62} |

## In a style
